gloss: no matter what, by all means

definitions.gloss: no matter what, by all means
definitions.explanation: Expresses strong determination or insistence. Used when someone absolutely wants or needs to do something.

definitions.gloss: just cannot, no matter how hard one tries
definitions.explanation: Used with negative expressions to indicate inability despite effort. Means 'simply cannot' or 'can't help but'.

examples.japanese: どうしても⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I really want to go no matter what.

examples.japanese: どうしても⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I just can't remember, no matter how hard I try.

examples.english: If you absolutely need it, I'll buy it for you.

examples.english: I really want to see her no matter what.

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どうしても⟦{認|みと}めようとしない→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: He simply won't admit it no matter what.

notes:
USAGE: どうしても has two main uses depending on whether it appears with affirmative or negative statements:

1. With AFFIRMATIVE statements:
- どうしても〜たい (really want to ~)
- どうしても〜する (will ~ no matter what)
- Expresses strong will or necessity

2. With NEGATIVE statements:
- どうしても〜ない (just cannot ~)
- どうしても〜できない (simply cannot ~)
- Expresses inability despite best efforts

USAGE:
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧ (strong will) - with positives
- ⟦{諦|あきら}め→諦め：07166_akirame⟧ (resignation, giving up) - with negatives

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何|なん}としても→何としても：16803_nantoshitemo⟧ (by any means necessary)
- ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (absolutely)
- ⟦どうあっても→どうあっても：noentry⟧ (no matter what happens)
